title: Colorado cleaned up Rocky Mountain Arsenal; refuge now supports more than 330 animal species
summary_full: The Rocky Mountain Arsenal National Wildlife Refuge in Colorado has undergone a remarkable transformation from a heavily contaminated chemical weapons and pesticide production site into a thriving wildlife sanctuary. This story explores the Arsenal’s polluted industrial past, decades-long cleanup and ongoing environmental monitoring, while highlighting the return of bison, bald eagles, black-footed ferrets and hundreds of other species.
